newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index down in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Monday closed down by 0.33 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 597.67 from 599.66.
Trade volume was 258,210 dinars against 2.54 million dinars.
Amen bank was down 2.99 percent to 55.67 dinars. UIB bank lost 2.15 percent to 12.15 dinars.
Airliner Tunis Air was up 1.45 percent to 16.69 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
